summary: Injuries drive tonight's NBA slate: Detroit is without Jalen Duren for at least two weeks, Sacramento is down to Sabonis and Achiuwa as healthy bigs, and Boston plays the second night of a back-to-back as a 12.5-point favorite. NFL Week 9 research waits for a later run.

CFB-week.summary: Only three midweek games, with very thin prop markets: just two numeric FanDuel lines were found. Western Kentucky has started Brock Glenn at QB in place of Rodney Tisdale Jr. for the last two games, and the DEL-WKU total has drifted from 58.5 to about 56.5 with WKU now a slight favorite. Delaware QB Nick Minicucci is playing through a leg injury.

NBA-BKN-at-BOS-1027.summary: Boston is a 12.5-point favorite, up from 11.5 at open, with a total near 221. The 0-3 Nets just lost by 27 to Indiana, and their starters played only 16-24 minutes as the game got away. Boston is on the second night of its first back-to-back but has nobody new on the injury report, so a lopsided game that cuts starters' minutes on both sides is the main prop risk. Brooklyn rookie Mikel Brown Jr. returns from rest, which crowds a guard rotation where Nolan Traore is already pushing Egor Demin for minutes.

NBA-DET-at-NY-1028.summary: Unbeaten Detroit (3-0) visits 0-3 New York without Jalen Duren (hamstring, re-eval ~Nov 8-9); Ausar Thompson (ankle) and Isaiah Joe (hip) are questionable, so Daniss Jenkins likely starts again and John Collins keeps soaking up center minutes behind Paul Reed. Market has Knicks -3.5 with the total up a point to 219.5; the Knicks' offense and bench are struggling and Brunson is carrying the scoring load.

NBA-POR-at-LAL-1028.summary: The Lakers (3-0) are 2.5-point home favorites over Portland (2-0), and the total has climbed to about 236.5, up from 228.5 in an earlier preview, so books expect a fast, high-scoring game. The Lakers play the Clippers the next night, but a close spread makes it less likely that starters sit late. Portland is missing Shaedon Sharpe, Scoot Henderson (ankle) and Branden Carlson (concussion) are questionable, and Jrue Holiday and Toumani Camara should defend Doncic and Reaves.

NBA-SAC-at-SA-1028.summary: Spurs are 18.5-point home favorites over an 0-3 Kings team missing Keegan Murray (10-14 days), Dylan Cardwell and Maxime Raynaud, so blowout risk caps Spurs starters' minutes (Wembanyama played only 32 in a 4-point loss to Houston). With three frontcourt players out, Sacramento's remaining minutes go to Achiuwa, who started and played 39 minutes Sunday, and to Sabonis. Harris is out again for San Antonio, but the three-guard starting five Mitch Johnson planned all along stays in place.

NBA-ATL-at-HOU-1027.summary: Second half of a home-and-home: Houston won 121-114 in Atlanta Saturday without Fred VanVleet and Steven Adams, out-rebounding the Hawks behind Amen Thompson's 11 boards. VanVleet is off the injury report and available Monday, Adams remains out with a calf strain, and Marcus Smart is questionable with a forearm strain, so the guard minutes Reed Sheppard and Tari Eason picked up Saturday may shrink.

NBA-GS-at-DEN-1027.summary: Golden State gets Stephen Curry, Brandin Podziemski, Draymond Green and Al Horford back after all four sat Saturday in Phoenix, which shrinks the roles of the fill-ins who played big minutes there. Gui Santos left that game with left knee tendinitis and is questionable. Denver lists Cameron Johnson and Alpha Diallo as doubtful.

NBA-IND-at-MIL-1027.summary: Indiana plays the second night of a back-to-back after beating Brooklyn, and center Ivica Zubac left on crutches with a sprained ankle (Carlisle called Monday unlikely); McConnell and Sheppard are out, leaving about 10 healthy players with Huff and Nance covering center. Milwaukee (0-3) is healthy, rested Sunday, and outrebounded Philadelphia 62-40 on Saturday. Pacers -4.5, total 239.5.

NFL-DAL-at-PHI-1027.summary: Philadelphia (2-4, four straight losses) starts Tanner McKee again with Jalen Hurts on IR, and is without WRs DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks, edge Nolan Smith and slot CB Michael Carter; Greenard missed Friday and Saturday practice. Barkley is reported set to return from a two-game hamstring absence with Bigsby and Shipley on IR. Dallas is -4.5 (opened -5.5), total 43.5-44, and is missing OT Drew Shelton and WR KaVontae Turpin.

best.why: Jalen Duren is officially out with a hamstring strain, and John Collins has taken most of Detroit's backup center minutes behind Paul Reed, grabbing 11 rebounds in the first game with that setup. The line has not moved off 6.5 and the book prices the over near a coin flip.
